The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The core components are deliberate: GitHub Pages for static hosting (free), Cloudflare Workers for serverless logic (free), NOWPayments for crypto processing (0.5% fee), and Google Sheets for order tracking (free). USDT on Tron ensures transactions confirm in under a minute for negligible fees. This stack bypasses all geographic payment restrictions. No Stripe, no PayPal, no intermediaries. The customer sends crypto, the webhook triggers file delivery, and the order logs in your sheet. Full sovereignty. Full control. Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Ignore custom domains, SSL certificates, and email marketing integrations for now. These are optimizations, not requirements. Focus on the payment pipeline first. USDT on Tron and Binance P2P are your immediate tools for liquidity. Do not waste time on KYC-compliant wallets or fiat gateways—they reintroduce the restrictions you’re escaping. The stack’s strength is its simplicity: host, process, verify, deliver. Once live, scale with Cloudflare’s edge network or COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced configurations. Speed is the priority. Deploy the essentials today.

Getting Your First Transaction Live

Share your store link with one trusted buyer to confirm end-to-end functionality. Document any friction points but do not over-optimize. The goal is a working pipeline, not perfection. Once confirmed, replicate the stack for additional products. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup and end-to-end testing for those scaling quickly.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept payments in Tanzanian shillings directly?

No, but Binance P2P allows you to convert USDT to shillings instantly. The stack processes crypto payments, which you then bridge to local currency. This avoids geographic restrictions on fiat payments.
What if a buyer does not have crypto?
Direct them to Binance P2P to purchase USDT with shillings. The process takes minutes and requires no buyer account. USDT on Tron ensures low fees and fast settlements.
Do I need to code this stack myself?
Not if you use COREMERCH’s pre-built templates. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys the full stack in 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all templates for self-deployment.
How do I handle refunds or disputes?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the buyer. Disputes are rare with digital products, but clear terms of service mitigate risk. The stack’s simplicity reduces friction points.
Can I scale this stack to hundreds of products?
Yes. Cloudflare’s edge network handles scaling. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes optimizations for high-volume stores. Start with the minimum viable stack, then expand as needed.
